items.author: Tommy Beer
items.body_excerpt:
OG Anunoby finished the 2026 playoffs with 22 points in the clutch, the third-most in the NBA, trailing only Jalen Brunson and Victor Wembanyama. 

And, remarkably, Anunoby shot 54.5% from the floor and 60% from three-point range in those clutch situations.
